description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class 'Returns' within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages customer return functionalities including listing returns, viewing return details, adding new returns, handling form submissions, and displaying return history.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class managing customer return operations within the Opencart platform, handling listing, details, creation, and history of product returns.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of returns for the logged-in customer, including pagination and breadcrumb navigation.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific return, including status, comments, and history.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Prepares and displays a form for submitting a new return request.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles submission of the return form, performing validation, saving data, and redirecting upon success.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays a confirmation page after successfully submitting a return request.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of status updates and comments related to a specific return.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Fetches and renders the paginated history entries for a specific return request.
